propositions: The portability criterion's 'Platform and venue' matrix cell must explicitly name both 'CI under any provider' and 'projects with NO CI provider at all' as distinct supported shapes to enable detection of CI-specific dependencies.

A capability whose only trigger is a specific CI system (e.g., GitHub Actions schedule with no operation-linked or in-process fallback) is not portable and must be detected as a project.portability finding when a plan would break on alternative CI providers or no CI.

The authoritative portability rule wording must exist in .rebar/prompts/plan-review-project-portability.md, with the docs and test assertions pinned to match it, and a single one-line pointer added to AGENTS.md.

Live detection must verify that rebar review-plan emits a project.portability finding for a plan with a GitHub-Actions-only trigger and no fallback under the new rubric, but did not under the pre-change rubric.
